title: Rate of change
description: The plain percentage move from the start of each window to now. The simplest read on which way and how fast.

roc_bps_10s.label: Change 10s
roc_bps_10s.description: The move over the last ten seconds, in basis points. Positive means up over the window.

roc_bps_1m.label: Change 1m
roc_bps_1m.description: The move over the last minute, in basis points. Positive means up over the window.

roc_bps_5m.label: Change 5m
roc_bps_5m.description: The move over the last five minutes, in basis points. Positive means up over the window.

roc_points_10s.label: Odds change 10s
roc_points_10s.description: How much the odds of Up moved over the last ten seconds, in probability points. Positive means the venue is warming to Up.

roc_points_1m.label: Odds change 1m
roc_points_1m.description: How much the odds of Up moved over the last minute, in probability points. Positive means the venue is warming to Up.

roc_points_5m.label: Odds change 5m
roc_points_5m.description: How much the odds of Up moved over the last five minutes, in probability points. The slow drift behind the shorter reads.
